episodes.title: How to Get Started
episodes.summary: What is meditation? Begin your journey toward a calmer, clearer mind by learning the basics and try a guided meditation that focuses on the breath.

episodes.title: How to Let Go
episodes.summary: Drop that baggage — and let go of anger, frustration and longing. This effortless guided meditation takes an easygoing approach to visualization.

episodes.title: How to Fall in Love with Life
episodes.summary: Pause for a moment of gratitude, and learn to listen to the mind. Andy explores ways to fall in love with life and introduces a reflection meditation.

episodes.title: How to Deal with Stress
episodes.summary: Overwhelmed? It often begins within. Change this relationship to anxiety and cope with stress using a simple, powerful meditation technique: noting.

episodes.title: How to be Kind
episodes.summary: Release resentment toward others — and oneself — and learn to live with greater compassion. Andy guides a loving kindness meditation.

episodes.title: How to Deal with Pain
episodes.summary: How do we experience pain? Be present without the suffering that feels unbearable, and bring the body and mind together with a body scan meditation.

episodes.title: How to Deal with Anger
episodes.summary: Transform your anger into something positive. Andy discusses how a shift in perspective can be a life-changing tool when relating to others.

episodes.title: How to Achieve Your Limitless Potential
episodes.summary: Open your mind. Andy explores why the possibilities are limitless with a consistent mindfulness practice and leads a resting awareness meditation.
